name: EN 'witness' x3, VN 'nhân chứng' x3
description: Verifies that 3 occurrences of the same English term get 3 distinct VN marks with sequential data-occ indices (0,1,2), and that the AI's raw marker order is the source of truth for pairing.
sourceText: The witness saw the witness. The witness left.
vnMarked: Nhân chứng đã thấy [[H:witness]]nhân chứng[[/H]]. [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] đã rời đi.

name: VN word-order swap: 'paradox of progress' → 'nghịch lý của tiến bộ'
description: Verifies that a multi-word phrase whose Vietnamese counterpart has swapped word order still gets ONE contiguous mark, not split fragments.
sourceText: The paradox of progress is striking.
vnMarked: Điều [[H:paradox of progress]]nghịch lý của tiến bộ[[/H]] thật đáng chú ý.

name: AI forgot 1 marker → fallback string-match covers it
description: Verifies that when AI wraps only 1 of 2 markers, the fallback pass still paints the missing one with a HIGHER occurrence index (preserving order).

name: VN has comma inside soft separator: 'Hơn nữa,' with trailing punctuation
description: Verifies that the soft-separator regex (zero-or-more punctuation between words) still matches 'Hơn nữa,' even though the candidate is 'hơn nữa' (no trailing comma).
regressGuard: tiếng Việt vẫn chưa bôi đậm hết

name: VN contains parens: '(hơn nữa)'
description: Verifies that the soft-separator regex tolerates parenthesis-wrapped phrases without breaking the match.
regressGuard: tiếng Việt vẫn chưa bôi đậm hết

name: Multi-word phrase: full match wins, no fragmenting
description: Verifies that when both the full phrase and a trimmed variant (e.g. 'tiến bộ' inside 'nghịch lý của tiến bộ') could match, the FULL phrase is used and the result is one contiguous mark. This is the 'tô lố / bôi lẻ tẻ' fix.

regressGuard: tô lố + tiếng Anh dò cả cụm, tiếng Việt bôi lẻ tẻ

name: Function-word bridge merge: 'Nghịch lý của sự tiến bộ' back into one mark
description: Verifies the PASS 2.5/2.6 chain-merge: when AI wraps only 'nghịch lý' and 'tiến bộ' separately, the merge passes must re-stitch them into ONE contiguous mark covering 'nghịch lý của sự tiến bộ'.

name: Same word in 2 paragraphs, EN-side mirrors VN-side
description: Verifies that when a term appears in 2 paragraphs on both sides, the per-paragraph loop + perKeyOcc continuation produce exactly 2 marks with occ 0 and 1.

name: AI forgot exactly 1 key — retry list identifies it for repairMissingMarkers()
description: Verifies that when the AI wraps 2 of 3 keys, _validateAndRepairMarkers() reports the missing key in missingEnKeys (and only that one). This is the INPUT CONTRACT for the retry-patch pass: app.handleTranslate() uses this list to feed translator.repairMissingMarkers() with ONLY the missing keys — no full re-translation. Required to validate option C (JSON patch chỉ gửi danh sách từ thiếu).
sourceText: Witness, progress, and paradigm walked in.

name: _stitchMissingPatches inserts new markers WITHOUT duplicating existing ones
description: Unit-tests the retry stitching function in isolation. Given a marked text already wrapping 2 keys, and patches for 3 keys (1 overlap with an existing marker span, 2 new), the result must wrap the 2 new keys WITHOUT duplicating the existing one (the overlapping patch must be rejected because its vn lives inside an existing [[H:...]]...[[/H]] span).
sourceText: Witness, progress, and a paradigm shift today.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]]. Một paradigm shift cũng xuất hiện hôm nay.
regressGuard: retry patch duplicate hoặc bỏ sót từ

name: LỚP 1.3 — every <mark> carries data-source tag (ai-verified / ai-retried / fallback)
description: Verifies the data-source tagging contract: marks emitted from PASS 1 (AI inline wrap) carry data-source='ai-verified', marks emitted from retry-stitched patches with verified=true carry 'ai-verified', verified=false carry 'ai-retried', and marks emitted from PASS 2 (string fallback) carry 'fallback'. The renderer MUST NEVER emit a <mark> with data-source='' or 'unknown' — every mark tells LỚP 2 how confident the machine was.
sourceText: Witness, progress, and a paradigm shift today.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]]. Một paradigm shift cũng xuất hiện hôm nay.
regressGuard: mark không có data-source → banner LỚP 2 không đếm được

name: LỚP 1.3 — mixed sources in one document: ai-verified + ai-retried + fallback all coexist
description: Verifies that when 1 mark comes from PASS 1 (ai-verified), 1 from retry patch (verified=true → ai-verified), and 1 from PASS 2 string fallback (fallback), the renderer tags each one correctly and the histogram is accurate.
sourceText: Witness, progress, paradigm shift, and resilience.
vnMarked: [[H:witness]]Nhân chứng[[/H]] và [[H:progress]]tiến bộ[[/H]] đã làm thay đổi mọi thứ. paradigm shift xuất hiện cuối cùng, mang lại khả năng phục hồi.
regressGuard: LỚP 1.3 phân biệt nguồn — không gộp tất cả thành 1 loại

name: LỚP 2.1 — banner counts {verified, needsCheck} accurately per data-source
description: Verifies the _updateVerificationBanner() contract: returns {verified, needsCheck} where verified = ai-verified + user-verified, needsCheck = ai-retried + fallback. This is what drives the banner UI text. We can't drive a real DOM here, so we replicate the counting logic and assert via the renderer output (data-source histogram).

regressGuard: banner đếm sai verified vs needsCheck

name: LỚP 1.3 — retry patch with verified=false tags the mark as ai-retried (⚠️ in UI)
description: Verifies that when the retry returns a patch with verified=false (closest-window match, NOT exact substring), the resulting mark is tagged data-source='ai-retried' — so the user sees the dashed border + ⚠️ icon and can confirm/fix it via LỚP 2.3.
